tokens.name: color-surface-map

tokens.name: color-surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels; unchanged.

tokens.name: color-surface-panel

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, help bubbles, chips on a panel.

tokens.name: color-surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of a row or control; the darkest surface every text token must pass on.

tokens.name: color-surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, active tab, active filter: opaque green, so text contrast does not depend on what lies behind.

tokens.name: color-surface-urgent
tokens.usage: Background of an emergency line in the journal or the list.

tokens.name: color-surface-warn
tokens.usage: Background of a warning line.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Values, callsigns, transcriptions. 10.9:1 on hover.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, types, secondary values. 7.2:1 on hover.

tokens.name: color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Units, timestamps, hints. 4.7:1 on hover: the floor.

tokens.name: color-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only (exempt from WCAG contrast).

tokens.name: color-text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a filled accent button.

tokens.name: color-text-on-urgent
tokens.usage: Text on the urgent fill.

tokens.name: color-text-on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on the warn fill.

tokens.name: color-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Row separators inside a panel.

tokens.name: color-border-default
tokens.usage: Panel edges, the main separator; unchanged.

tokens.name: color-border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of an input, an unchecked box, an off toggle: at least 3:1 on panel, raised and hover (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: color-border-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (2 px).

tokens.name: color-accent-default
tokens.usage: The tool's voice: brand, live, selected, focus. One green only (the #4ADE80 of the sign-in page goes).

tokens.name: color-accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent text on the selected surface when more weight is needed (8.1:1 on panel).

tokens.name: color-accent-fill
tokens.usage: Filled primary button (sign in, save).

tokens.name: color-status-urgent
tokens.usage: Emergency and failure, as text or icon; always with a shape or word.

tokens.name: color-status-urgent-fill
tokens.usage: Emergency badge (white text 6.5:1), always outlined with status.urgent (6.4:1 on panel), which detaches it from the panel. Darker than the accent so that a deuteranope tells them apart by lightness (ΔE 18).

tokens.name: color-status-warn
tokens.usage: Attention: degraded service, weak match, go-around, runway change.

tokens.name: color-status-info
tokens.usage: Neutral information that is not the tool's voice: help marker, link.

tokens.name: color-status-ok
tokens.usage: Status light 'ok' = the accent: a working chain is a live chain.

tokens.name: color-status-unknown
tokens.usage: Status light 'unknown' = tertiary text, hollow shape.

tokens.name: color-phase-ground
tokens.usage: TAX. Sand: the earth.

tokens.name: color-phase-departure
tokens.usage: T/O, CLB, DEP. Warm: leaving.

tokens.name: color-phase-cruise
tokens.usage: CRZ. Pale sky: high and passing.

tokens.name: color-phase-arrival
tokens.usage: ARR, APP, T/D. Blue: coming in.

tokens.name: color-phase-unknown
tokens.usage: NEW, UNK. Grey: nothing known yet.

tokens.name: color-altitude-dark-very-low

tokens.name: color-altitude-dark-low
tokens.usage: Low: pink.

tokens.name: color-altitude-dark-mid
tokens.usage: Mid: violet.

tokens.name: color-altitude-dark-high
tokens.usage: High: cyan.

tokens.name: color-altitude-dark-cruise
tokens.usage: Cruise: slate, the quietest: the most numerous and the least relevant to a local listener.

tokens.name: color-altitude-light-very-low

tokens.name: color-altitude-light-low
tokens.usage: Low: dark plum.

tokens.name: color-altitude-light-mid
tokens.usage: Mid: violet.

tokens.name: color-altitude-light-high
tokens.usage: High: dark teal.

tokens.name: color-altitude-light-cruise
tokens.usage: Cruise: slate, the quietest.

tokens.name: color-map-airport
tokens.usage: Large and medium airports, symbol and code (medium ones were #34D399, a green dE76 2.2 from the ground phase at worst, and the accent's family).

tokens.name: color-map-airport-small
tokens.usage: Small aerodromes and seaplane bases (these were #2DD4BF, dE76 3.4 from a low aircraft at worst).

tokens.name: color-map-heliport
tokens.usage: Heliport symbol and code: violet, with the small aerodromes; it was #FB923C, dE76 3.3 from the departure phase at worst.

tokens.name: color-map-navaid-vor
tokens.usage: VOR and VOR-DME.

tokens.name: color-map-navaid-vortac
tokens.usage: VORTAC.

tokens.name: color-map-navaid-ndb
tokens.usage: NDB.

tokens.name: color-map-navaid-dme
tokens.usage: DME alone.

tokens.name: color-map-runway
tokens.usage: Runway in the airport layout.

tokens.name: color-map-centerline
tokens.usage: Extended runway centrelines, dashed: grey, were #76C76C, dE76 1.2 from the accent; they cross the whole map.

tokens.name: color-map-taxiway
tokens.usage: Taxiway: grey, was pale yellow (#efe3a0), dE76 6.6 from a very low aircraft at worst.

tokens.name: color-map-ring
tokens.usage: Range rings: grey, were the accent.

tokens.name: color-map-ring-label
tokens.usage: Range ring labels ("10 NM"): the tertiary text.

tokens.name: color-map-selected
tokens.usage: Ring of the selected aircraft, 2 px: the accent, was #FDE047.

tokens.name: color-map-hovered
tokens.usage: Ring of the hovered aircraft, 1.2 px: primary text, was #86EFAC.

tokens.name: color-map-trail-followed
tokens.usage: Track of the followed aircraft, dashed. Other aircraft's trails take their altitude colour at 50 %.

tokens.name: color-map-estimate
tokens.usage: Estimated positions, dotted: the future and the hindcast (were #FFC107 and #00BCD4).

tokens.name: color-map-trail-stale
tokens.usage: Trail of an aircraft whose position is getting old or lost: tertiary, as the lost glyph.

tokens.name: color-map-proximity
tokens.usage: The Nearby tab's circle around the followed aircraft, dashed, fill at 6 %: it belongs to the followed flight; was #EB8C00, dE76 0.9 from the departure phase.

tokens.name: color-map-light-ring
tokens.usage: Range rings on a light base map (IGN, OSM).

tokens.name: color-map-light-centerline
tokens.usage: Extended centrelines on a light base map.

tokens.name: color-map-light-proximity
tokens.usage: The Nearby circle on a light base map.

tokens.name: color-map-light-taxiway
tokens.usage: Taxiway on a light base map.

tokens.name: color-map-light-selected
tokens.usage: Selection ring on a light base map (4.5:1 on the OSM ground).

tokens.name: color-map-light-hovered
tokens.usage: Hover ring on a light base map.

tokens.name: color-map-light-trail-stale
tokens.usage: Old or lost trail on a light base map.

tokens.name: color-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a full page (settings) over the map: black at 70 %.
